about_short_description.short_description: endl is a fintech platform that offers stablecoin neobanking services.

product.name: Multicurrency Bank Accounts
product.description: Accounts that allow users to hold, send, and receive multiple fiat currencies including USD, EUR, GBP, and others from a single platform.

product.name: Stablecoin Payments and On-Off Ramps
product.description: A platform service that facilitates seamless conversion and transfer between stablecoins and fiat currencies, supporting crypto-to-fiat and fiat-to-crypto transactions.

product.name: Global Cross-Border Payments and Payouts
product.description: A service enabling fast, secure, and compliant cross-border payments and bulk payouts in multiple currencies to over 100 countries.

product.name: Crypto Payment Cards (Coming Soon)
product.description: A card product that enables users to spend crypto assets by off-ramping stablecoins into fiat through supported card networks.

product.name: Yield on Deposit (Coming Soon)
product.description: A service that allows users to earn passive yield on deposited funds through integration with decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols.
